# Pixiecoded by Kavya Devda (Heyokavya)

> Official personal portfolio, creative workspace, and professional profile of Kavya Devda.

## About Kavya Devda
- Full Name: Kavya Devda
- Known as: Heyokavya / Pixie
- Primary Roles: Digital Marketer, Social Media Strategist, Content Creator, Technology Builder, Founder of PIXIE OS
- Location: Gujarat, India
- Education: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) at KSKV Kachchh University
- Specialisations: Digital marketing, social media management, brand strategy, personal branding, B2B sales outreach, lead generation, client acquisition, financial modelling, and AI-assisted no-code development.
- Certifications & Programs: Technology Entrepreneurship (Harvard Business School Online), Digital Marketing Course (Google), AI Training Program (OutSkill), Master in Tally Accounting (Sculp Institution).

## Core Projects
- **PIXIE OS** (https://pixieos.heyokavya.workers.dev): A social media management command center founded and developed by Kavya Devda. Unifies brand strategy, campaign planning, content creation, scheduling, and analytics into one connected workspace.
- **FRIDAY**: An AI assistant experiment developed by Kavya Devda exploring voice-driven research and personal productivity workflows.
- **Nest & Form Interiors**: Full-scope brand identity, competitor research, pricing strategy, Canva pitch deck, and Excel financial model for a fictional interior studio.
- **Pixiecoded**: Personal identity and creative portfolio website (https://kavyadevda.heyokavya.workers.dev/).

## Professional Capabilities & Services
1. Company & Brand Research: Structured business model analysis, competitor research, and market positioning.
2. Business Ideas & Strategy: Market validation, customer profiling, positioning, and pricing strategy.
3. Excel & Financial Modelling: Budgets, financial assumptions, expense forecasting, and unit economics.
4. Social Media Management & Presence: Content calendars, visual storytelling, brand voice, and audience engagement.
5. Canva Design & Presentations: Pitch decks, business presentations, social carousels, and visual collateral.
6. AI-Powered Websites & No-Code Building: Fast prototyping, landing pages, digital workspace automation, and no-code builds.
7. Sales & Client Acquisition: Cold calling, cold DM outreach, prospect research, sales communication, pitching & proposals, follow-ups & lead nurturing, and needs discovery.
